name: chromatic-wave
title: Chromatic Wave
description: A soft wave travels down through the type; where it crosses, the letters ripple and split into RGB fringes, then settle back to white.
useWhen: A held title (an album cover, a poster hold, a loop) needs slow, ambient distortion instead of a one-shot entrance.
The look is music-video or vaporwave: rippling glass with red, green and blue fringes at the distortion edges.
The type can sit on a dark background: the channel split sums back to white via screen blending, exact only over black.
avoidWhen: You need a quick glitch accent rather than a five-second traveling wave: use rgb-glitch-text.
The background is light: the screen blend that reassembles the channels breaks over anything but dark fills.
The copy enters or changes mid-scene: the type is static, this is a treatment, not a reveal.
author: Remocn

variables.description: Small spaced word above and below the headline.

variables.description: Text color. The channel split reassembles to this over a dark background.
